findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因素：法規變動、執法優先順序變化可能造成更高合規成本、資本支出與生產成本，或須重新配方。
findings.excerpt: Changes in applicable laws or regulations or evolving interpretations thereof, changes in enforcement priorities of regulators, and differing or competing regulations and standards across the markets where our products or raw materials are made, manufactured, distributed or sold, have in the past resulted in, and could continue to result in, higher compliance costs, higher capital expenditures and higher production costs, or make it necessary for us to reformulate certain of our products, resulting in adverse effects on our business.

findings.claim: 歐盟執委會 2025 年 3 月突擊檢查非酒精飲料業者，疑涉市場劃分；報導稱可口可樂為受查者之一，官方未點名，無法定結案期限。搜尋未見 2026 年進展。
findings.source: Fidelity/Bloomberg: Coca-Cola Facilities in Europe Targeted in EU Antitrust Raids

findings.claim: 土耳其競爭委員會 2025 年 6 月對 Coca-Cola Satış ve Dağıtım AŞ 啟動調查，涉零售獨家性，審查是否遵守 2021 年承諾。
findings.source: Turkish Competition Authority: Investigation Launched on Coca-Cola Satış ve Dağıtım AŞ

findings.claim: 佛州檢察長辦公室 2026 年 4 月向可口可樂、聯合利華、雀巢等發出資料調取，涉及與環保團體減塑合作是否違反反壟斷與消費者保護法；屬傳票階段，非壟斷訴訟。
findings.source: Bloomberg Government: Coca-Cola, Nestle, Unilever Targeted in Florida Antitrust Push

regulatory_antitrust.note: 搜尋未見 2026 年美國聯邦（DOJ/FTC）針對 KO 的反壟斷或拆分動作；FTC 2023 年 1 月羅賓遜-帕特曼法調查報導現況未查到。Florida as_of 為推估月份。
